title: Borel push-forward of a Borel field through a continuous map injective on a Borel set (Lusin–Souslin)
statement: Let n, P, Q ∈ ℕ (ℝᵏ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) with its Borel σ-algebra), let D ⊆ ℝⁿ be a Borel set, let Φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P be continuous on D and injective on D, and let γ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^Q be Borel measurable. Then there is a Borel measurable g : ℝ^P → ℝ^Q with g(Φ(w)) = γ(w) for every w ∈ D and g(y) = 0 for every y ∈ ℝ^P ∖ Φ(D).
lean_statement: ∀ (n P Q : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P) (D : Set (Eucl n)) (γ : Eucl n → Eucl Q), MeasurableSet D → ContinuousOn Φ D → InjOn Φ D → Measurable γ → ∃ g : Eucl P → Eucl Q, Measurable g ∧ (∀ w ∈ D, g (Φ w) = γ w) ∧ ∀ y, y ∉ Φ '' D → g y = 0
